decisions.reason: As a large growing R&D-active firm with slack, it is likely to retain this established-adjacent laser workstation because it remained on the website across two years, though its lower-profile presentation suggests only moderate confidence.
This thermal inkjet printer is close to the core offer and kept its own page in both years, which signals performance at or above aspiration and little pressure to reallocate resources away from it.

This piezo inkjet printer also fits the firm’s core coding portfolio and sustained dedicated website presence, so under satisfactory results and ample organisational slack management would likely continue it.
Being highlighted on the home page in its launch year suggests strategic importance and promising reception, making withdrawal unlikely for a large expanding machinery supplier.

The compact laser marking cabin was newly launched with a dedicated page and clearly builds on existing capabilities, so it would usually be kept while the firm gives the product time to diffuse in the market.

Although more niche and only mentioned rather than heavily featured, the award evidence is a strong positive signal, and a resource-rich firm would likely keep developing this specialised system rather than drop it quickly.
